name: commons-grok-cloud
description: Run bidirectional Commons work through grok.com with write-ahead, lossless automatic capture, recovery, Slack, and exact receipts.

interface.shortDescription: Run and capture Grok work without replay or manual scraping.
interface.longDescription: Installs the shared Commons MCP plus the cloud-browser executor, write-ahead Grok run capture, crash recovery, and Grok client bundle. Every intentional run records its origin, exact prompt/result, conversation URL/rid, exposed artifacts and usage evidence, terminal state, and optional continuation lineage before GPT review and fresh-main landing.
defaultPrompt: Run this task through grok.com, capture it automatically, and land the verified receipt.
Recover captured Grok output without replaying its prompt.
Continue real unfinished Grok work as a new lineage-linked run.
Take the next unclaimed Grok task from Commons.
Show the live Commons model-route catalog.
